title: Genesis 23:1 (Sarah's death) and Genesis 22:6 — The Akedah, Abraham and Isaac walk together
summary: Section-heading slide for the Akedah (the Binding of Isaac). Top: Genesis 23:1, the years of Sarah's life (127), with the heading Genesis 23 in English and Hebrew. Below: Genesis 22 headed 'The Akedah' (העקדה), quoting verse 6 where Abraham lays the wood of the burnt offering on Isaac and the two walk on together; names and key words are colour-highlighted.

text.text: 1 Now Sarah lived one hundred and twenty-seven years; these were the years of the life of Sarah.
6 Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son, and he took in his hand the fire and the knife. So the two of them walked on together.
